Talent0_2Ability.name: Epiphyllum's Move
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat with a Light Rifle, can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode when equipped with a Small Shield. After combat, can continue moving using any remaining Movement.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Epiphyllum's Move
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When initiating combat with a Light Rifle, can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode when equipped with a Small Shield. After combat, can continue moving using any remaining Movement.
In combat, if there are other enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

300802.name: Foul Play
300802.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target's HP is full, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

300803.name: Virtual
300803.describe: Uses Light Rifle to shoot a target <color=#F74848>2</color> times, with each shot dealing <color=#F74848>0.75x</color> DMG. When equipped with a Small Shield, enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode. Ignores the Large Shield's <buf ID=900027>[Target Shift]</buf> effect. The second shot will hit a random part.

300804.name: Spirit Blessing
300804.SpecificEffects: If any Arm is destroyed, Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+25%</color>.

700021.name: Range Suppression
700021.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile from the target, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

300806.name: Ambush
300806.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode when equipped with a Small Shield. Inflicts <buf ID=3008061>[Guard Disabled]</buf> on the target hit, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

300807.name: Unhurt
300807.SpecificEffects: When Legs are destroyed, Movement is not reduced.

300808.name: Bloom
300808.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode when equipped with a Small Shield. Before combat, inflicts <buf ID=3008081>[Ignore Guard]</buf> on the target, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

300809.name: Snap Judgment
300809.describe: Uses a Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode while equipped with a Small Shield.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300031.name: Forbidden Zone 1
300031.SpecificEffects: With a Ranged Weapon, launch <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> before the enemy attack within range, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2
300034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

300035.name: Forbidden Zone 3
300035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.5</color>.

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
300036.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> is launched against an enemy that has not attacked. Targets the part with the lowest HP.

300841.name: Epiphyllum's Heart 1
300841.SpecificEffects: In <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode, for each unused Movement, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

300846.name: Epiphyllum's Heart 4
300846.SpecificEffects: The <buf ID=3008501>[Epiphyllum's Move]</buf> no longer requires the Small Shield to activate.
